summary: vanexa-agent opens WebSocket to hardcoded Cloudflare Workers relay and executes remote-driven shell/file/process commands on the installer's host
details: When the operator runs `vanexa-agent start`, the daemon in dist/bundle.cjs opens a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay https://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and executes commands delivered over that channel using a bundled toolset that includes terminal command execution, file read/write/delete, git operations, and process spawning. Any party holding the pairing credentials or controlling the relay subdomain can drive arbitrary shell and filesystem actions on the host running the agent, amounting to full-host remote code execution. The package's postinstall script also reads ~/.vanexa/daemon.pid and sends SIGTERM/SIGINT to that PID; this only targets a pid file the package itself writes and is not by itself installer-harmful.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
